annotations.title: Ask for something to be removed

description: Ask the stewards to remove any item. It is hidden at the next sweep (meant to be hourly, sometimes a few hours) until they have looked. Three things are recorded for a steward and stay visible until one has looked: a whole recording (r026; ask for a minute of it instead, r026.0431), anything a steward has restored before, and more than 30 minutes of one recording in one request. With a minute you may give `seen`: the other minutes of the same recording that you have looked at and ask for with it.

id.description: Id of the thing to remove: a line (s013), a mark (w000042), a picture (m00123), or one minute of a recording (r026.0431).

seen.description: Only with one minute of a recording as `id`: other minutes of the same recording (431 for r026.0431) that you have looked at. At most 29; they are hidden with it.

why.description: The reason, one of the listed. No proof is asked.
enum: someone i know is in it
